simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אֲבִיאָסָף (H23) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: אֲבִיאָסָף (ʼĂbîyʼâçâph) means Abiasaph , an Israelite First listed occurrence: Exod 6 24.

definitions.full: H23. Abiasaph אֲבִיאָסָף proper name, masculine ( my father has gathered ) son (descendant) of Korah Exod 6:24 , Samaritan אביסף , so אֶבְיָסָף 1Chr 6:8 ; 6:22 ; 9:19 (compare Nes Eg 185 ).
definitions.rootNote: from 1 and 622 ; father of gathering (i.e. gatherer);
